comment: Expected failures caused by the Kotlin SDK (kotlin-sdk master, 3af219a) or the Kotlin programs (programs/kotlin). Citations are relative to the kotlin-sdk root; M = acp-model/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/agentclientprotocol/model.

expectations.reason: Kotlin ClientCapabilities has no session field, so the Kotlin client cannot advertise session.configOptions.boolean
the Kotlin client cannot advertise session.configOptions.boolean, so no agent offers the boolean option verbose to it
Kotlin AuthCapabilities has only _meta, so the Kotlin client cannot advertise auth.terminal and no agent lists its terminal auth method
Kotlin v1 SessionUpdate.ToolCall has no name field, so the client cannot read the tool call name

ToolCallStatus (and ToolKind, ToolCall.kt:18) is a closed Kotlin enum and ACPJson has no coerceInputValues, so a tool_call with an unknown status fails to decode and the SDK drops the whole update (the turn goes on)
PlanEntryPriority and PlanEntryStatus (Plan.kt:36) are closed Kotlin enums, so a plan with unknown values fails to decode and the SDK drops the update

expectations.contains: StopReason does not contain element with name 'interop_future_stop'
expectations.reason: StopReason is a closed Kotlin enum: the PromptResponse with stopReason interop_future_stop fails to decode and the prompt call fails (-32700); the session still answers the next prompt
A Kotlin agent answers a prompt only with a PromptResponse, whose StopReason is a closed enum, so it cannot send an unknown stop reason; the program answers -32603 instead

expectations.contains: Role does not contain element with name 'interop_future_role'
expectations.reason: Role is a closed Kotlin enum, so the SDK fails to decode a prompt whose annotations.audience holds an unknown Role and answers -32700 before the handler runs
